The Heather Grey Selvedge is a 13.5oz Japanese selvedge denim woven using what Japanese mills refer to as top-dyed yarns. Rather than dyeing finished yarns a single flat color, grey cotton fibers in different tones are blended together at the fiber stage before spinning. This mixing of light and dark grey fibers is what creates the fabric’s heathered appearance, similar to classic mixed-grey sweatshirts.
Because the color is achieved through fiber blending rather than surface dyeing, subtle tonal variations remain visible throughout the yarn and fabric. The result is a naturally layered grey with depth and visual softness, avoiding the flat, uniform look of piece-dyed or yarn-dyed greys.
Initially rigid, the denim is designed to break in gradually with wear. Over time, the fabric softens and molds to the body while retaining its structure and textured character. The end result is a refined grey selvedge denim that balances durability, comfort, and understated visual complexity.
Easy Guy is a relaxed tapered fit with extra room through the seat, hips, and thighs. A sharp taper from knee to hem keeps the silhouette clean.

p-ironheart-9551619031306.d:
Our relaxed tapered cut jeans in 14oz indigo overdyed black selvedge denim. Utilising a double-twisted weft yarn (the same as our signature 21oz weave), this crisp, mid-weight denim provides exceptional durability and comfort straight off the rack without the lengthy break-in period commonly associated with our heavier-weight fabrics. This fabric is woven with rope-dyed indigo warp and white weft yarns — it may not be our heaviest denim, but it fades with the best of them!
To create this darkened variation, we take a pair of standard IH-888S-142 jeans and steep the entire garment in black dye using a sulphur dyeing process. This stains the indigo denim and stitching, and oxidises the metal hardware — with the added bonus of removing all shrinkage from the fabric. A unique middle ground between our traditional indigo and black denims, over time the fabric will gradually fade with blue-tinged hues in high-wear areas.
